name: Dem Supermercati
note: Supermarket chain with stores across Lazio and Abruzzo (own site) and Frosinone Calcio's back sponsor (own sponsor page; Ciociaria Oggi, 2026-04-26). The supermercatidem.com footer reads 'Copyright © DSG HOLDING srl – Sede legale: Viale Kennedy 70 00043 Ciampino, (RM), IT – P.IVA: 09325141001', and the chain's history page says its roots go back to the 1980s 'grazie alla famiglia De Sanctis'; neither page states who owns DSG Holding srl, so no ownership claim could be written and the sponsor stays unrated.
